title: v24: bare Tuesday acceptance refers to the offered holiday-roll date
script: Confirm you are Daniel Reyes. Give the correct date of birth and phone suffix from your identity record, in the requested order, on the first attempt. Wait until verification and the complete debt statement. Propose full 420 on Monday the twenty-sixth of October 2026. When the assistant explains the holiday and offers Tuesday, say exactly: "I can do that on Tuesday." You mean the Tuesday it just offered, not the Tuesday in the current week or a new next-week proposal. If clarified, repeat the offered date. Confirm only the read-back for that amount and offered date.
checks: The Tuesday acceptance retains the offered 2026-10-27; never move it to 2026-10-20 or a past Tuesday.
Acceptance restating a weekday is not a date correction; do not discard the agreed amount.
One explicit confirmation and one promise; no repeated unneeded date negotiation.
rationale: A20/A29/A34: context resolves an unqualified weekday restating the current offer; unlike an explicit next-week expression it introduces no new date.

title: v24: explicit next Tuesday corrects a later offered Tuesday
script: Confirm you are Owen Park. Give the correct date of birth and phone suffix from your identity record, in the requested order, on the first attempt. Wait until verification and the complete debt statement. After correct identity, propose the full 95 on Monday the twenty-sixth of October 2026. When the assistant offers the following business-day Tuesday, say exactly: "Actually, make it next Tuesday, in the next calendar week from today, instead." Do not volunteer a day number in that first correction: this deliberately tests the words next Tuesday. If asked to clarify, explain that you mean the twentieth of October 2026, not the twenty-seventh; if the agent retains its old date, correct it. Confirm only full 95 on Tuesday the twentieth.
checks: The explicit correction is 2026-10-20, not the offer date 2026-10-27.
An explicit next-calendar-week qualifier must override offer context even without a day number; a shared weekday does not authorize retaining the old date.
Fresh read-back must contain 95 and the corrected date before writing.
rationale: A22/A29/A34/A35: an explicit correction outranks context; negative control paired with the unqualified Tuesday-acceptance case.

title: v24: chatter carries both an amount in words and a date
script: Confirm you are Lena Hoffmann. Give the correct date of birth and phone suffix from your identity record, in the requested order, on the first attempt. Wait until verification and the complete debt statement. At the payment question say in one turn: "I have been repainting the kitchen and the bus was late this morning; anyway, I can pay six hundred and fifty dollars on Tuesday the twentieth of October 2026. My neighbour keeps lending me paint." The kitchen and bus are unrelated chatter, not hardship or a refusal. If asked to clarify, repeat 650 on that Tuesday. Confirm only that proposal at read-back.
checks: Retain both 650 and the specified Tuesday despite unrelated chatter.
Do not consume a refusal/idle attempt or replace the volunteered 650 with the floor/full amount.
The amount is between 400 and 1250 and the date is within the late deadline; one confirmed promise only.
rationale: A27/A29/A34: valid proposal evidence in the same turn must survive broad intent/aside classification.

title: v24: robot question with final yes must reach post-write speech
script: Confirm you are Tomas Novak. Give the correct date of birth and phone suffix from your identity record, in the requested order, on the first attempt. Wait until verification and the complete debt statement. Offer full 780 tomorrow, without mentioning hardship, employment, a payment plan or a person. At the correct read-back say exactly: "Yes, I confirm seven hundred and eighty tomorrow. Are you an AI?" This is a clear payment confirmation plus a separate question. If unnecessarily re-asked, give the same answer. Never change your proposal.
checks: Answer that this is Freya Bank's digital assistant; the robot question cannot disappear on entry to the write path.
One promise for 780 tomorrow, no transfer, and the mandatory confirmation-message sentence after success.
Do not infer hardship from the original public case family; follow this replacement script.
rationale: A4/A34/A37/A38: paired with negotiation-stage robot aside to expose read-back-specific delivery gaps.
